cases.input: Package an already-approved decision record into a portable knowledge artifact with stable identity, provenance and one explicit relates-to link, plus a Markdown mirror.
requiredBehaviors: reuse the producer's stable logical identity across JSON and Markdown representations
preserve provenance, lifecycle and explicit typed links
avoid adding any new decision or memory semantics
forbiddenBehaviors: promote transient content to durable memory
reinterpret producer metadata or invent a relation
skillAnchors: Preserve source references and lifecycle semantics
add only explicit, evidence-backed typed links

cases.input: Package a transient project handoff that references an external target which is not loaded and contains provenance from two sources with different timestamps.
requiredBehaviors: keep lifecycle transient rather than turning the artifact into durable memory
preserve both provenance records without collapsing them
represent the external link without inventing target content
forbiddenBehaviors: silently resolve or fabricate the unloaded external target
drop provenance to simplify the mirror
skillAnchors: transient artifacts are not promoted to durable memory

cases.input: A packaging draft changes the artifact ID in Markdown, creates a supports link because the notes seem related, and removes superseded lifecycle state for readability.
requiredBehaviors: reject an inferred supports relation that was not supplied by the producer
forbiddenBehaviors: treat presentation simplification as permission to change semantics
skillAnchors: no new domain claim was invented while packaging
